title: Allow defining a custom icon for outputs, which then becomes the CompactRepresentation's icon when that output is active
line: You can now give each audio device its own icon in Rename Devices, and the system tray shows it while that device is active.
explanation: The Audio Volume tray icon was always a speaker picked from the default output's volume and mute state, so it looked the same whichever output was active; the device was only named in the tooltip and popup. Rename Devices could only change a device's name. Rename Devices now has an icon button next to each device that opens the standard icon picker and stores the choice as a plasma-pa.icon-name property in the same WirePlumber rule it already writes. When the active output has such an icon, the tray shows it with the usual volume icon as a small badge in its bottom-right corner, so the volume level and mute state stay visible.

commits.message:
applet: show a custom per-device icon in the system tray

The tray icon was always a speaker, so you couldn't tell at a glance which
output was active. Rename Devices can now set an icon for each device, and
the tray shows it with the volume icon as a small badge in its corner.

BUG: 527280

patches.diff:
From e860b2e54c89f0bfa70ad4557b9ce9fe8fc8ca20 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 19:05:50 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applet: show a custom per-device icon in the system tray

The tray icon was always a speaker, so you couldn't tell at a glance which
output was active. Rename Devices can now set an icon for each device, and
the tray shows it with the volume icon as a small badge in its corner.

BUG: 527280
---
 applet/main.qml              | 26 ++++++++++++++++++++++++++
 src/kcm/ui/RenameDevices.qml | 26 ++++++++++++++++++++++++++
 2 files changed, 52 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applet/main.qml b/applet/main.qml
index 1e44cded..29cff128 100644
--- a/applet/main.qml
+++ b/applet/main.qml
@@ -83,6 +83,8 @@ PlasmoidItem {
 
     Plasmoid.icon: PreferredDevice.sink && !isDummyOutput(PreferredDevice.sink) ? AudioIcon.forVolume(volumePercent(PreferredDevice.sink.volume), PreferredDevice.sink.muted, "")
                                                                                 : AudioIcon.forVolume(0, true, "")
+    // Set per device in the Rename Devices dialog
+    readonly property string customIconName: PreferredDevice.sink && !isDummyOutput(PreferredDevice.sink) ? PreferredDevice.sink.properties["plasma-pa.icon-name"] ?? "" : ""
     hideOnWindowDeactivate: !Plasmoid.configuration.pin
     toolTipMainText: {
         var sink = PreferredDevice.sink
@@ -261,9 +263,33 @@ PlasmoidItem {
         }
         Kirigami.Icon {
             anchors.fill: parent
+            visible: main.customIconName === ""
             source: plasmoid.icon
             active: parent.containsMouse
         }
+
+        Item {
+            anchors.fill: parent
+            visible: main.customIconName !== ""
+
+            Kirigami.Icon {
+                anchors.top: parent.top
+                anchors.left: parent.left
+                width: Math.round(parent.width * 0.75)
+                height: Math.round(parent.height * 0.75)
+                source: main.customIconName
+                active: parent.parent.containsMouse
+            }
+
+            Kirigami.Icon {
+                anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
+                anchors.right: parent.right
+                width: Math.round(parent.width * 0.5)
+                height: Math.round(parent.height * 0.5)
+                source: plasmoid.icon
+                active: parent.parent.containsMouse
+            }
+        }
     }
 
     VolumeFeedback {
diff --git a/src/kcm/ui/RenameDevices.qml b/src/kcm/ui/RenameDevices.qml
index ac272681..cc1b4ee1 100644
--- a/src/kcm/ui/RenameDevices.qml
+++ b/src/kcm/ui/RenameDevices.qml
@@ -10,6 +10,7 @@ import QtQuick.Layouts
 import QtQuick.Controls
 
 import org.kde.coreaddons as KCoreAddons
+import org.kde.iconthemes as KIconThemes
 import org.kde.kcmutils as KCM
 import org.kde.kitemmodels as KItemModels
 import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
@@ -119,6 +120,31 @@ KCM.ScrollViewKCM {
                 return ''
             }
 
+            Button {
+                readonly property string customIconName: delegate.pulseProperties["plasma-pa.icon-name"] ?? ""
+
+                icon.name: customIconName || "audio-volume-high-symbolic"
+                display: AbstractButton.IconOnly
+                text: i18nc("@action:button", "Choose the icon shown in the system tray while this device is active")
+                onClicked: iconDialog.open()
+
+                ToolTip.text: text
+                ToolTip.visible: hovered
+                ToolTip.delay: Kirigami.Units.toolTipDelay
+
+                KIconThemes.IconDialog {
+                    id: iconDialog
+                    onIconNameChanged: iconName => {
+                        if (!iconName) {
+                            return
+                        }
+                        let properties = delegate.pulseProperties
+                        properties["plasma-pa.icon-name"] = iconName
+                        PulseProperties = properties
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+
             Kirigami.ActionTextField {
                 id: textField
                 Layout.fillWidth: true
--

media.caption: Headphones active: plain speaker tray icon, the device is only in the tooltip
Headphones active with a headphones icon set: the tray shows headphones with the volume badge
Surround active: exactly the same tray icon
Surround active (no custom icon): the usual speaker icon, so the two are told apart at a glance
Rename Devices: only names can be changed
Rename Devices: an icon button before each name opens the icon picker; Headphones shows its chosen icon
